requirements.title: Protected macOS and Linux credentials
requirements.current: Windows Vault explicitly rejects non-nt.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Add native backend parity with app/database namespace binding and no plaintext fallback.
requirements.acceptance: Real macOS Keychain and Linux Secret Service roundtrip/rotation/delete, unavailable-service denial and snapshot exclusion.

requirements.title: Cross-platform native agents
requirements.current: Discovery paths select Windows executables; generic process code has POSIX support, Studio ownership is Windows-only.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Add reviewed per-OS CLI identity and owned process-tree controls; do not call POSIX process spawning complete parity.
requirements.acceptance: Real installed Codex/Claude detection, safe profile, version drift, cancellation and descendant cleanup on each OS.

requirements.title: No plaintext fallback
requirements.current: Current Vault fails closed.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Preserve invariant across new backends and providers.
requirements.acceptance: Secret sentinel absent from files/logs/exports; missing vault rejects rather than downgrades.

requirements.title: Visible capability matrix
requirements.current: Windows-specific setup explains its requirement, but a consistent platform matrix is absent from inspected surfaces.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Show supported, unavailable and untested capabilities with one concrete setup/recovery action.
requirements.acceptance: Windows/macOS/Linux capability snapshots agree with actual adapter availability and rendered setup.

requirements.title: Progressive introduction
requirements.current: Guided workflow and next action already exist; guidedView renders every stage by default.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Lead with current recommended work; keep full workflow and blockers explicitly accessible.
requirements.acceptance: Fresh/resumed/complete apps show focused stage, discoverable full steps, stable progress and no concealed critical findings.

requirements.title: Stage purpose and acceptance
requirements.current: Descriptions, direct missing inputs and verify text already exist.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Make purpose, needed input, delivered artifact and verification consistently scannable.
requirements.acceptance: Every stage has plain-language purpose/input/deliverable/acceptance and keyboard-accessible detail.

requirements.title: Separate preparation approval execution outcomes
requirements.current: Current guided classification and copy separate input readiness from release approval.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Use consistent visible evidence-state labels across onboarding, reviews and results.
requirements.acceptance: Operators can distinguish prepared, approved, executed and independently observed states in desktop/mobile tasks.

requirements.title: Isolated synthetic starter
requirements.current: Synthetic tests/examples exist; a dedicated user-facing complete starter journey is not established.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Add explicitly synthetic isolated starter without changing real workspace evidence or credential bindings.
requirements.acceptance: Starter creation/reset/export never copies authority and cannot satisfy a real-app readiness gate.

requirements.title: Unified event chronology
requirements.current: Audit rows, checkpoints, job events and source histories exist separately.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Join app-owned proposal/approval/execution/tracking/recovery references with causal links where recorded.
requirements.acceptance: Chronological/causal events reconstruct a complete workflow; absent links stay absent, not inferred.

requirements.title: Linked provenance
requirements.current: Domain receipts already carry hashes and IDs; unified navigation is missing.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Link timeline events to original app-owned current or historical receipt.
requirements.acceptance: Exact source/hash readback, stale/missing-source state, foreign-app denial and no secret payload leakage.

requirements.title: History type/status filters
requirements.current: No unified filtered timeline was identified in the inspected surfaces.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Add bounded cursor pagination and type/status filters to shared human/agent history reads.
requirements.acceptance: Filter consistency, stable pagination and explicit incomplete coverage on realistic synthetic histories.

requirements.title: Browser-independent local awareness
requirements.current: Worker telemetry is present; no local OS notification/tray channel was identified.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Add opt-in local terminal/expiry/recovery notices with deduplication and quiet defaults.
requirements.acceptance: With browser closed, supported OS notices reflect durable actual state; denied permission, dismissal and restart do not duplicate.

requirements.title: Cross-app active work
requirements.current: Weekly portfolio exceptions already exist, but complete active sequence/approval coverage is not present.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Extend existing weekly projection with active jobs, sequences, expiring approvals and prioritized next actions.
requirements.acceptance: App coverage/cursors, failures and timestamps remain explicit; no unobserved zero or global success.

requirements.title: Current versus proposed comparison
requirements.current: Website setup already shows saved values and editable suggestions.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Generalize exact field diffs to supported agent proposal types.
requirements.acceptance: User sees old/new/current scope; intervening edits invalidate approval.

requirements.title: Per-field provenance
requirements.current: Setup source fingerprints and suggestion labels exist.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Standardize public-source/agent/human provenance and source excerpts or references.
requirements.acceptance: No private reasoning disclosure; each field traces to recorded evidence or an explicit unsupported suggestion.

requirements.title: Selective exact approval
requirements.current: Website setup already supports selected-field approval.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Extend selection to other typed proposal domains by producing a newly bound exact approved subset.
requirements.acceptance: Subset hash/version/expiry validated; dependency/conflict changes require a new review; never silently approve remaining fields.

requirements.title: Repeated keyboard review
requirements.current: Dialogs and some focus restoration exist; no end-to-end repeated-review efficiency proof.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Improve keyboard sequence, conflict navigation and focus return without default approval.
requirements.acceptance: Keyboard-only repeated review and cancellation across desktop/mobile; focus never escapes or activates approval implicitly.

requirements.title: Observed versus missing
requirements.current: Tracking already returns observed_counts/flag_findings and explicit failure states.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Project observed/missing/mismatched/stale evidence into a clear decision surface.
requirements.acceptance: Partial data/zero/missing/unavailable remain distinct; no causal or sample-size inference.

requirements.title: Counts are not causal lift
requirements.current: Current tracking copy explicitly says flag evaluation is not a confirmed view.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Keep warning and metric definitions adjacent to every new comparison/chart.
requirements.acceptance: No chart or export converts provider distinct IDs into humans/exposures/conversions/lift.

requirements.title: Durable experiment decisions
requirements.current: Experiment lifecycle and growth/customer review records already retain decisions/results.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Add convenient linked human notes where missing and expose their immutable history.
requirements.acceptance: Note save/reopen/history/export and exact experiment/source links; human note is not provider verification.

requirements.title: Instrumentation integration state
requirements.current: Package generation/download and source-bound validation exist; in-system installation/probe progression is incomplete.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Track generated/downloaded/reported-installed/probe-observed separately with guided next steps.
requirements.acceptance: Download never means installed; attestation never means verified delivery; exact live probe identity/time/scope retained.

requirements.title: Portfolio readiness and active sequences
requirements.current: Weekly inbox already evaluates five apps per page with explicit coverage.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Extend rather than replace with current stage, high-priority gaps and active sequence counts.
requirements.acceptance: Full paginated app coverage, unavailable app handling, source timestamps and no comparison of incompatible metrics.

requirements.title: Structured export/import
requirements.current: Store.export/restore already implement app snapshot validation and authority exclusions.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Reuse and document current capability; add scoped structure-only import if needed for templates.
requirements.acceptance: Roundtrip version/hash validation and explicit authority exclusions; do not reimplement snapshot machinery.

requirements.title: Reusable workspace templates
requirements.current: No curated/user structure-only workspace-template mechanism identified.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Add versioned non-credential templates with selection preview and conflict handling.
requirements.acceptance: New app identity, no secrets/approval grants/verified evidence/source event IDs copied; examples remain synthetic.

requirements.title: Connection health and scope recovery
requirements.current: Protected connection setup, social flows and source-progress recovery already exist.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Unify health/current scope/expiry/last read/failure/next action in context.
requirements.acceptance: Each supported provider shows current observed state and one exact recovery path; login is not analytics permission.

requirements.title: Prioritized recovery
requirements.current: Guided next actions and weekly recovery cards exist.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Use common action projection and deep links across empty/error/stale/expired states.
requirements.acceptance: One highest-priority actionable recovery, preserved drafts, exact affected source and stale-action rejection.

requirements.title: Additional read integrations
requirements.current: App Store Connect reviews/catalog and Apple Ads report reads already exist; not solely Play/PostHog.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Inventory missing requested ASC/analytics reads and implement demand-backed read-only adapters under exact consent.
requirements.acceptance: Official provider contract and account readback, app/scope/page bounds, source hashes, approval expiry and error recovery; no broad provider capability claim.

requirements.title: Actionable empty/error states
requirements.current: Nanna stories, guided next action and many recovery dialogs exist.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Audit every page/state for one concrete prioritized next action.
requirements.acceptance: No dead end, no success on failed source; source-bound action retains user inputs and cancels safely.

requirements.title: Keyboard/focus consistency
requirements.current: Dialog focus support exists in individual paths; global optimized parity is unproven.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Apply shared initial focus, trap, Escape, return-focus and async stale-dialog handling.
requirements.acceptance: Keyboard/screen-reader repeated flows, no destructive default focus and no detached dialog focus after app switch.

requirements.title: Scannable evidence states
requirements.current: Existing labels and non-claim copy are distributed across pages.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Use consistent text+shape/icon semantics in pages/reviews/timeline/PDF.
requirements.acceptance: Not color-only; prepared/approved/executed/observed/unknown understandable at a glance and in export.

requirements.title: Desktop/mobile workflow parity
requirements.current: Existing rendered desktop/mobile proofs cover several flows; not every new flow.
requirements.authorized_resolution: Extend real browser acceptance for each changed critical flow.
requirements.acceptance: Actual desktop/mobile no overflow, touch/keyboard usable, focus preserved, PDF readable; report untested flows explicitly.

nfr.requirement: Native protected credentials only; no plaintext or secret export
Exact current hash/version/expiry and human/standing approval scope
No new spend or publication permission from this gap program
Measured realistic history/portfolio/review performance; define benchmark profile before claiming acceptable
CF current candidate hashes, meaningful execution/mutation/browser evidence and honest uncovered scope

corrections: Guided onboarding, stage explanations and next-step guidance exist; progressive density remains a gap.
Portfolio weekly exceptions already exist; active-work/readiness breadth remains partial.
Structured snapshot export/import already exists; reusable structure-only templates remain missing.
Selected-field website discovery approval exists; wider agent proposal parity remains partial.
ASC reads and social status/recovery paths already exist; inventory gaps instead of treating providers as absent.
General process code has POSIX support; native detection/vault/owned Studio parity is not cross-platform.
scope_conflicts: The report non-goal about a general creative suite does not remove already authorized complete Hypit/OpenCut/marketer controls.
No automatic publication/spend is newly authorized; existing explicit standing human scope remains governed by its own exact approval, not removed by this report.
OS credential/process acceptance requires real macOS/Linux execution; Windows mocks cannot prove it.
No extra analytics provider is selected without current product demand and a bounded official interface.
implementation_sequence: P0 progressive onboarding, action hierarchy and evidence-state language using existing guided components
P0 native vault/agent platform parity with real OS acceptance tracks
P0 unified causal timeline and extended existing portfolio active work
P1 exact diff/provenance/selective review and repeated keyboard flows
P1 opt-in local notifications, uncertainty-preserving result visualization and instrumentation state
P2 safe reusable templates and demand-backed read integrations
